text: Here is how the owner emails an estimate and records the customer's approval.
The owner emails the estimate straight from the system. The message comes from a template, with the PDF attached. They check it and click Send. The estimate now shows who it went to and when.
The customer calls back. They want Unit 14 wrapped now, but not Unit 17. The owner opens Record approval.
The owner approves Unit 14 and declines Unit 17. They record who approved, when, and how. Here it was a phone call. Then they save.
The approval record now shows on the estimate. Unit 17 is crossed out, and the total covers only Unit 14. When the deposit check arrives, the owner records it.
